sup:70740.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are delighted to present our competitive quote for your requirements. Our price is €6.10 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel of 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

move.text:
Dear customer,
Many thanks for your e-mail, and great to hear from you; I went through it right away with our team.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €5.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 36 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.
A few words on this from our side.
We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. That remains.
LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. That remains.
PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. That remains.
We acknowledge your data regarding the AS-14404 index decrease, the increased demand forecast, and our recent delivery performance.
We can agree to your requested 36-month contract and 60-day payment terms, but we must include an AS-14404 index clause as we cannot fix prices for this duration.
With these terms, we propose a revised unit price of €5.50.
Alternatively, with a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.50 per unit.
Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C.
We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404.
We look forward to doing good business together, and our team is always there for you.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C. In response to your adjustment, we can lower our price to €5.30 per unit. We are pleased to maintain the 36-month contract, 60-day payment terms, and the AS-14404 index clause as requested. 

So, our Angebot stands at a price of €5.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 36 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Our standard terms apply to everything the quote does not state; see attached. This offer stays valid for 30 days. As your distributor, we value our relationship and are always glad to work together on your supply needs!

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

Dear customer,

Thank you for your ongoing partnership with Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH. We always value our business relationship and are keen to keep supporting your requirements with our reliable service and broad product range.

Please consider this our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide based on these terms: a price of €5.20 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 36 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. We must maintain the AS-14404 index clause to manage material cost risks over this extended period. Therefore, our offer remains at €5.20 per unit with the index clause included. 

Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C. As part of our options, we can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404. 

Please note that this offer stays valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH
